# Board card-height test fails on a subpixel inline-edit change

## Context

The Board card editor example keeps the card visually in place during inline title editing. The height assertion on the Engine E2E suite failed twice on `71e4d413c3`, blocking #21810. Its app, CSS, and test are unchanged in that PR. [First job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44940451830/job/136956912261) · [Failed-only retry](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44940451830/job/136959398630)

## The Problem

Both Chromium jobs measured 91.109375 CSS px before editing and 91.203125 CSS px during editing, a delta of 0.09375 px. The precision-1 matcher accepts less than 0.05 px. The same case passed on the preceding SEO revision and on the current `dev` shard. Three focused local headless runs also passed. [Current dev shard](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44940201962/job/136955560048)

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: #21630 requires the card to retain its size during the inline edit. #21712 records the 91.1 px to 95.9 px regression that the geometry check protects. The title is a text line box. The editor uses a native input sized with `1lh` and inherits the title typography. The observed delta is subpixel. [Board card style](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c26fcf115652d49814b19db46cd9bf3e22dbd2fa/resources/css/src/board/Card.css#L59-L89) · [Current matcher](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c26fcf115652d49814b19db46cd9bf3e22dbd2fa/test/playwright/e2e/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs#L56-L64)

## The Fix

Make the existing CardEditor geometry assertion use an explicit CSS-pixel tolerance of 0.25 for this before/during comparison. Keep the existing rename, Escape and focus checks. The same tolerance is used on the Gantt geometry assertion. [Precedent](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c26fcf115652d49814b19db46cd9bf3e22dbd2fa/test/playwright/e2e/gantt/BasicNL.spec.mjs#L53-L63)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The 0.09375 px observed delta passes. A change of 0.25 px or larger fails, including the 4.8 px growth recorded in #21712.
- [ ] The named CardEditor case passes in the hosted Engine shard on the repair head. Enter, Escape and focus checks remain in place.

## Out of Scope

Board CardEditor features, release SEO generation and changes to the app’s styles.
